job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain scalable web applications with end-to-end frontend and backend ownership.
Integrate AI services (e.g., Claude, OpenAI, or similar) into applications for chatbots, content generation, and intelligent automation.
Design and implement RESTful APIs and manage database systems (SQL/NoSQL) for efficient data flow.
Collaborate with product and design teams to translate AI-driven features into user-friendly interfaces.
Optimize AI integration for performance, reliability, and compliance with data privacy standards.

Skills & Requirements:

Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript (React, Node.js) or Python (Django, Flask, FastAPI).
Hands-on experience working with AI APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar).
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus.
Solid understanding of software engineering best practices, version control (Git), and testing.

Location - Remote,Delhi NCR, Bangalore, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Hyderabad
